title: iris xiphium var. fontanesii
intro: Iris xiphium var. fontanesii, commonly known as Spanish iris, is a plant species within the iris genus. It is known for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Spanish iris include wound healing, antiseptic, and antiviral effects, primarily attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides. Research has identified bioactive constituents, including iridoid glycosides, which contribute to the plant's medicinal properties.
